title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription:
P0201 sets when the PCM detects an injector circuit fault on cylinder 1. Extended diagnostic uses an injector test light to confirm pulse signal at the connector while cranking.

Most faults trace to a failed injector winding, broken connector pin, or a corroded ground.

title: Cylinder 2 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0202 sets for cyl 2 injector circuit fault. Diagnose with noid light and resistance check.

title: Cylinder 3 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0203 sets for cyl 3 injector circuit fault.

title: Cylinder 4 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0204 sets for cyl 4 injector circuit fault.

title: Cylinder 5 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0205 sets for cyl 5 injector circuit fault.

title: Cylinder 6 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0206 sets for cyl 6 injector circuit fault.

title: Cylinder 7 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0207 covers cyl 7 injector fault on V8 engines.

title: Cylinder 8 Injector Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0208 covers cyl 8 injector fault.

title: Engine Coolant Over Temperature Extended
fullDescription: P0217 sets when coolant temperature exceeded a critical threshold. Indicates active or recent overheating event.

title: Transmission Over Temperature Extended
fullDescription: P0218 sets when ATF temperature exceeded critical threshold. Often after towing or stop-and-go in heat.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Fluid + filter; aux cooler if towing.

title: Engine Overspeed Condition Extended
fullDescription: P0219 logs when the PCM detected engine over-rev. Common after a missed downshift on a manual.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Check oil and listen for noise.

title: Throttle Position Sensor B Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0220 sets when TPS B (second track) circuit reading is invalid. Modern drive-by-wire uses dual TPS for redundancy.

title: TPS B Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0222 sets with TPS B signal below threshold.

title: TPS B High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0223 sets with TPS B signal above threshold.

title: Fuel Pump Primary Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0230 sets when fuel pump primary control circuit has a fault. Common after relay or harness corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Pump check
fixSteps.instruction: Listen for pump prime; check pressure.

title: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit Low Extended
shortDescription: Fuel pump secondary circuit reads low.
fullDescription: P0231 sets when secondary side of fuel pump circuit reads below threshold during operation.

title: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit High Extended
shortDescription: Fuel pump secondary circuit reads high.
fullDescription: P0232 sets with secondary fuel pump circuit voltage above threshold. Usually a stuck-on relay or short to power.

title: Turbocharger Overboost Condition Extended
fullDescription: P0234 sets when actual boost pressure is above commanded threshold. Often a stuck wastegate or boost solenoid issue.

title: Turbocharger Boost Sensor A Circuit Extended
shortDescription: Boost pressure sensor A circuit fault.
fullDescription: P0235 sets when boost pressure sensor A reads invalid. Extended path verifies signal vs MAP.

title: Turbo Boost Sensor A Range/Performance
fullDescription: P0236 sets when sensor reads plausible but doesn't track expected boost behavior.

title: Turbo Boost Sensor A Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0237 sets with sensor signal below threshold. Short or failed sensor.

title: Turbo Boost Sensor A High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0238 sets with sensor signal above threshold.

title: Turbo Boost Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
fullDescription: P0240 covers boost sensor B range/performance fault on twin-turbo systems.

title: Turbo Wastegate Solenoid A Low Extended
fullDescription: P0245 sets when wastegate solenoid control circuit voltage is below threshold.

title: Turbo Wastegate Solenoid A High Extended
fullDescription: P0246 sets when wastegate solenoid voltage is above threshold.

title: Turbo Underboost Condition Extended
fullDescription: P0299 sets when actual boost is below desired. Common cause: boost leak or failing turbo.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor A Extended Diagnostic
fullDescription: P0500 sets when VSS signal is missing. Extended path verifies signal at PCM and TCM.

title: Brake Switch A/B Correlation Extended
shortDescription: Brake switch A and B disagree.
fullDescription: P0504 sets when the two brake switch signals don't agree. Common after switch replacement or adjustment.

title: Idle Control System RPM Lower Than Expected
fullDescription: P0506 sets when idle is below target. Common causes: dirty throttle body, vacuum leak, failed IAC valve.

title: Idle Control System RPM Higher Than Expected
fullDescription: P0507 sets when idle is above target. Often vacuum leak or stuck purge valve.

title: Idle Air Control Circuit Low Extended
fullDescription: P0508 sets when idle air control circuit voltage is below threshold.

title: Idle Air Control Circuit High Extended
fullDescription: P0509 sets when IAC circuit voltage exceeds threshold.

title: AC Refrigerant Pressure Sensor Low Input
fullDescription: P0532 sets when AC refrigerant pressure sensor reads below threshold. Often low refrigerant or sensor short.

title: AC Refrigerant Pressure Sensor High Input
fullDescription: P0533 sets when AC pressure sensor reads above threshold.

title: System Voltage Malfunction Extended
fullDescription: P0560 sets when system voltage is invalid. Extended path verifies battery and charging system.

title: System Voltage Low Extended
fullDescription: P0562 sets when system voltage is below threshold while engine is running.

title: System Voltage High Extended
fullDescription: P0563 sets when system voltage is above threshold. Usually a failed voltage regulator.

title: Cruise Control/Brake Switch A Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0571 sets when brake switch A signal is invalid for cruise logic. Often a failed brake switch.

title: Park/Neutral Switch Input Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0850 sets when PNP switch input is invalid. Common after worn switch.

title: Trans Fluid Pressure Low Extended
fullDescription: P0868 sets when measured transmission line pressure is below desired. Causes: low fluid, worn pump, valve body issue.

title: OD Pressure Switch Performance Extended
fullDescription: P0871 sets when overdrive clutch pressure switch reading is implausible vs commanded.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Fit new switch or valve body.

title: UD Pressure Switch Performance
fullDescription: P0875 sets when underdrive clutch pressure switch behavior is wrong.

title: TCM Power Input Signal Extended
fullDescription: P0880 sets when the TCM detects an invalid power input. Often a failing alternator or TCM power feed issue.

title: TCM Power Relay Sense Circuit Low
fullDescription: P0885 sets when TCM relay sense circuit reads low.

title: Transmission Component Slipping Extended
fullDescription: P0894 sets when TCM detects a clutch or band slipping. Indicates internal wear.

title: Shift Time Too Short Extended
fullDescription: P0895 sets when shift time is below expected range. Often pressure or solenoid issue.

title: Trans Fluid Deteriorated Extended
fullDescription: P0897 sets when TCM determines ATF is past usable life. Common with neglected service intervals.

fixSteps.title: Reset counter
fixSteps.instruction: Reset fluid life via scan tool.

title: Clutch Actuator Circuit/Open Extended
fullDescription: P0900 sets when the auto-clutch actuator circuit is open. Common on automated manuals (DCT/AMT).

title: Clutch Actuator Circuit Range/Performance
fullDescription: P0901 sets when clutch actuator response is outside expected range.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Fit new actuator if adapt fails.

title: Clutch Actuator Circuit Low Extended
fullDescription: P0902 sets when clutch actuator circuit reads below threshold.

title: Gate Select Position Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0905 sets when gate select sensor signal is invalid on AMT/DCT transmissions.

title: Gear Shift Position Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0915 sets when gear shift position signal is invalid.

title: Gear Shift Lock Solenoid Control Circuit
fullDescription: P0928 sets when shift lock solenoid control circuit has a fault. Affects ability to move out of park.

title: Hydraulic Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
shortDescription: Hydraulic pressure sensor out of range.
fullDescription: P0934 sets when transmission hydraulic pressure sensor reads outside expected window.

title: Hydraulic Pressure Loss of Pressure
fullDescription: P0944 sets when hydraulic pump can't maintain pressure. Indicates pump or internal leak.

title: Pressure Control Solenoid A Low Extended
shortDescription: Pressure control solenoid A circuit low.
fullDescription: P0962 sets when pressure control solenoid A circuit reads below threshold.

title: Pressure Control Solenoid B Low
shortDescription: Pressure control solenoid B circuit low.
fullDescription: P0966 sets when PCS B circuit reads below threshold.

title: Pressure Control Solenoid C Control Circuit
fullDescription: P0970 sets when PCS C control circuit has a fault.
